summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features on AirYatra: (1) Customer Watchlist page, (2) Bid Now navigation to /exchange?mode=auctions, (3) Unwatch + re-watch flow, (4) CEO Dashboard Investor emails dialog (save 2, restore to 1), (5) Send Now board report, (6) Regression: Board Report (PDF) download button. All flows PASS.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused seeded auction auc-9a4f47d2 (King Air 250) and loyaltytest customer.
test_credentials: Customer loyaltytest@airyatra.com / Loyalty@123; Admin admin@airyatra.com / Admin123!
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final state preserved as required: (a) loyaltytest is watching auc-9a4f47d2 King Air 250 (item re-added after unwatch test); (b) investor list restored to just loyaltytest@airyatra.com. Send Now was invoked once and produced toast 'Board report emailed to 1 of 1 investor(s)'. Watchlist countdown displays at minutes granularity ('1d 23h 6m'), so a 3-second observation window does not visibly tick — this is expected behaviour, not a bug (component uses setInterval but the text only changes each minute at this range).
verified_flows: Customer /customer/watchlist renders [data-testid=my-watchlist] with 1 item (King Air 250), LIVE badge, '1 watching', watchlist-timer-auc-9a4f47d2 present ('1d 23h 6m').
bid-now-auc-9a4f47d2 -> navigates to /exchange?mode=auctions with live-auctions-grid visible.
unwatch-auc-9a4f47d2 -> empty state [data-testid=no-watchlist] and empty-explore-auctions-btn appear.
watch-auction-btn-auc-9a4f47d2 on /exchange?mode=auctions -> 'Watching!' toast; item returns to watchlist.
Admin -> Analytics & Reports -> nav-ceo -> CEO Dashboard.
investor-emails-btn opens investor-emails-dialog with textarea prefilled 'loyaltytest@airyatra.com' and 'Last sent' info.
Save with 2 emails -> '2 investor email(s) saved' toast. Restore to 1 -> '1 investor email(s) saved' toast.
send-report-now-btn -> 'Board report emailed to 1 of 1 investor(s)' toast (received within ~5s).
Regression: download-board-report-btn present and visible on CEO Dashboard.
